thread:
Maya Singh: quick sync  we need to prioritize SKU slotting for the marketplace wave next month. H100/H200/B200/MI300/Gaudi — who is pushing what and what are the hard blockers? :wave:
Liam O'Connor: H100 + B200 are green from infra side. H200 has a pending power/thermal FW ticket from vendor that might affect sustained perf. MI300 is waiting on kernel driver 1.14 rollout, ETA ~10 days. Gaudi has network stack tweaks but low risk.
Samir Desai: SI integration note: our SI partners need final images 7 days before the rehearsals. if MI300 or H200 slip we must decide whether to rehearse with fallbacks.
Maya Singh: timeline: marketplace freeze = 2026-05-10T00:00Z. press window target 2026-05-12. need final list by 2026-05-03 EOD.
Nora Lee: product ask: can we publish a "validated SKUs" table in the marketplace UI that shows GA vs staggered availability? makes partner comms easier.
Liam O'Connor: ops proposal: primary wave = H100,B200,Gaudi. gated wave = H200,MI300 until vendor/driver validations pass. we can do a 2% canary for H200 if vendor signs a patch and we add runtime routing fallback.
VendorBot: vendor-update: H200 firmware v3.0 candidate submitted. preliminary lab tests show improvement on long seq but need internal stress pass. ETA 72h.
Samir Desai: for SI rehearsals, proposed approach: run two rehearsal tracks — one with target SKUs (if available) and one with fallback SKUs. That reduces rework.
Maya Singh: can ops sketch the routing policy change? sample command to route market_beta to fallbacks:
```
redwood route update --route market_beta --preferred-skus H100,B200,Gaudi --fallback H200,MI300 --canary 0.02
```
Liam O'Connor: that works. we should also add a healthcheck that drains H200 for >5m if perf drops.
Nora Lee: communications: we'll need embargo-safe phrasing if H200/MI300 are delayed. Draft: "Initial marketplace availability includes validated SKUs; additional hardware variants will roll out as partner validations complete."
Maya Singh: decision needed: accept Liam's primary/gated split and proceed with rehearsals using fallbacks, or try to accelerate vendor validations to include H200/MI300 in wave1. vote: +1 proceed with split, -1 try to accelerate.
Liam O'Connor: +1
Samir Desai: +1 (rehearsal dual-track recommended)
Nora Lee: +1 (comms ready)
VendorBot: reminder: next vendor lab pass scheduled in 48h.
Maya Singh: ok consensus reached. action items:
- Ops (Liam): implement routing policy + canary + health drain. target toggle in staging today.
- Vendor liaison (Maya): push vendor for 48h lab pass and share logs.
- SI leads (Samir): schedule dual-track rehearsals and update runbooks.
- Comms (Nora): prep embargo-safe announcement and partner-facing FAQ.
announce-bot: Marketplace freeze deadline set to 2026-05-10T00:00Z.
Maya Singh: I'll update the slotting sheet (link: https://docs.internal/redwood/marketplace/slotting) and ping partners. thanks everyone! :pray:
